failure_modes.description: Structural candidate with different molecular formula accepted after code computed the formula
failure_modes.fix: Phase 1 locks the molecular formula from code. Phase 4 rejects any candidate with a different formula via RDKit MolecularFormula check.

failure_modes.description: Degree of unsaturation not verified against the candidate structure
failure_modes.fix: Phase 4: compute DoU for every candidate and require it matches Phase 1 DoU.

failure_modes.description: Ozonolysis single-product clue misinterpreted — symmetric structure not considered
failure_modes.fix: Phase 3: if only one ozonolysis product observed, check symmetry (two identical fragments from symmetric parent).

failure_modes.description: HBr monobromination count not used to filter structural candidates
failure_modes.fix: Phase 3: enumerate all distinct monobromination positions, count chiral ones, compare to problem statement.

failure_modes.description: NMR signal count not verified per candidate — asymmetric molecule accepted as having fewer signals than it does
failure_modes.fix: Phase 4: enumerate all distinct proton/carbon environments by symmetry for each candidate; reject if count ≠ stated NMR signals.

failure_modes.description: Numerical mismatch (equivalent weight, molar mass) dismissed as 'likely typo' without checking alternative interpretations
failure_modes.fix: Phase 4: treat numerical mismatches as real contradictions; explore alternative acid valencies or formula multipliers before concluding typo.
